title: ForgePass AI Summary PromptContext Schema
description: Machine-readable schema for the data object passed to the Anthropic API for contributor summary generation. Every field present in a valid PromptContext instance has passed the runtime privacy filter. Fields absent from a PromptContext instance are absent because they are NEVER-INCLUDE fields or because the contributor's privacy_settings excluded them. See docs/ai-summary-prompt.md for the full field classification rationale.
generated_by: ForgePass Issue #007 - AI Summary Prompt Fields and Privacy Review

contributor.description: Core contributor metadata. All four fields are ALWAYS-INCLUDE. Never filtered by privacy_settings.

github_username.description: ALWAYS-INCLUDE. Verified GitHub username. Null when no GitHub account linked. Referenced by system prompt Rule 9.

ecosystem_tenure_days.description: ALWAYS-INCLUDE. Derived from passports.created_at. Full days since passport creation.

trust_score.description: ALWAYS-INCLUDE. Current computed Trust Score (0-100). System prompt Rule 6 instructs the model to describe it as a computed contribution metric.

score_computed_at.description: ALWAYS-INCLUDE. ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent Trust Score computation.

credentials.description: COND-INCLUDE. Absent when all four signal types are private. Individual sub-keys absent when the corresponding signal type is private. Absent means the key does not exist, not null, not empty object.

total_merged.description: Total merged pull requests across all registered Stellar repositories.

repository_count.description: Number of distinct repositories in which at least one PR was merged.

total_deployed.description: Total Soroban contracts deployed by the contributor's wallet.

total_invocations.description: Cumulative invocation count across all deployed contracts.

stellar_dex.description: COND-INCLUDE. Absent when privacy_settings.dex = false. Covers STELLAR_DEX credentials. AQUARIUS_LP is a scoring sub-signal under the dex privacy key with no separate toggle.

total_trades.description: Total DEX trades recorded for the contributor's wallet.

events.description: Event names only. No dates, wallet addresses, placements, or identifiers. Transformation applied at the data fetch layer.

badges.description: ALWAYS-INCLUDE. Always present as an array; may be empty. Independent of privacy_settings per FR-05.5. Capped at 10 most recent, ordered by minted_at descending.

milestone_type.description: Milestone type identifier. Values defined in milestone-registry.json from Issue #008.

minted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of on-chain badge mint.

collaborations.description: COND-INCLUDE. Absent when all signal types are private. Sub-keys absent when the corresponding signal type is private. Third-party wallet addresses and project names are NEVER-INCLUDE.

co_pr_count.description: COND-INCLUDE. Unique contributors co-authored or co-reviewed PRs with. Absent when privacy_settings.github = false.

co_contract_count.description: COND-INCLUDE. Unique contributors co-deployed Soroban contracts with. Absent when privacy_settings.soroban = false.

score_breakdown.description: COND-INCLUDE with all-or-nothing rule (Option B). Absent when ANY of the four signal types is private. Never partially populated. SQL WHERE clause requires all four privacy_settings keys to be true or returns zero rows.
score_breakdown.privacy_settings_condition: ALL of privacy_settings->>'github', ->>'soroban', ->>'dex', ->>'hackathon' must equal true
score_breakdown.omission_policy: Option B: absent when ANY signal type is private. Partial percentages omitted because they allow inference of private signal existence via arithmetic. Re-normalised percentages omitted because they misrepresent actual score composition.

github_pct.description: GitHub PR signal percentage contribution to total Trust Score.

soroban_pct.description: Soroban contract signal percentage contribution to total Trust Score.

dex_pct.description: Stellar DEX and Aquarius LP signal percentage contribution to total Trust Score.

hackathon_pct.description: Hackathon participation signal percentage contribution to total Trust Score.

absence_rules.note: Absent means the key is not present in the object. Not null. Not empty object. Not zero. The key does not exist.

rules.absent_when: All four signal types are private
All four signal types are private
ANY signal type is private (Option B)
Never absent. Always an array. May be empty.

validation_rules.opt_in_gate: ai_summary_opt_in must equal true before fetchPromptContext is called. Throws OptInRequiredError if false. No database read. No Anthropic API call.
validation_rules.retry_scope: Across all failure types combined per generation cycle

changelog.summary: Initial schema. 42 fields across 5 FRD Section 17 models classified. Five open questions resolved. score_breakdown: Option B (full omission when any signal private). Absence: silent omission. All-signals-private: generate minimal summary. GitHub username: JSON context only. Legal review: deferred to future phase.
